name: Free FAFSA Help
description: Free expert help completing FAFSA and Dream Act applications to maximize financial aid
fullDescription: Free help completing the FAFSA (Free Application for Federal Student Aid) is available through California Cash for College workshops and other programs.
whatTheyOffer:
- Free FAFSA completion workshops and webinars
- Help with California Dream Act Application (CADAA)
- Assistance with financial aid forms and next steps
- Virtual and in-person options available
- Aimed at high school seniors and parents, but open to returning college students and juniors
- Help understanding financial aid awards
howToGetIt:
1. Find a Cash for College workshop or webinar near you
2. Bring your StudentAid.gov login (FAFSA filers), Social Security or Alien Registration Number, and tax return
3. Parents/contributors bring their StudentAid.gov login, tax return, bank balances, and untaxed income and asset info
4. Submit the FAFSA or CADAA by the March 2 state priority deadline (September 2 for community college students)
5. Questions: email cashforcollege@csac.ca.gov or call CSAC Student Support
keywords: FAFSA, financial aid, college, federal aid, Pell Grant, student loans, free help, application, form, CSAC, Cash for College
